summary:
Comprehensive plan to enhance the multi-language and currency experience on Tiqsey:
- Add Hindi (hi), Korean (ko), and Portuguese (pt) with complete translation mappings and fallback handling.
- Full UI translation coverage across all views, search bar, booking modals, and checkout vouchers.
- Auto-detect browser language with a non-intrusive one-click switch banner.
- Full RTL layout support for Arabic (text direction, mirrored arrow icons, and spacing).
- Live exchange rates with updated timestamps and transparent conversion transparency.
- Auto-detect local currency with location confirmation toast and localStorage persistence.
- Dual price display showing prominent converted amount with original base price reference.
- Regionally grouped currency selector (Popular, Europe, Americas, Asia & Pacific, Middle East & Africa).
- Quick-switch dropdown menus in the header for 1-click switching plus the full modal selector.
